jobs.description:
1 Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems Your mission
Ownership Lifestyle Check - lab systems 

 * Taking over and owning the on-site Windows service that bridges our medical measurement devices to the platform. It drives around 10 device families via Bluetooth, serial, TCP and file exchange. 
 * Operation, maintenance and further development of the device drivers, the local REST API, the system-tray status UI, firmware updates and the Windows installer. 
 * Building and shipping releases: PyInstaller executable, NSIS installer, Windows Defender/firewall handling, auto-update mechanism and the PT10 ESP32 firmware flasher. 
 * Rolling out releases to the lab sites and troubleshooting problems that occur on-site - including occasional travel to our locations. 
 * Securing and documenting the systems so they can be maintained by more than one person in the long run. 

Lab operator frontend and backend

 * Owning the lab operator web app, an Angular / Ionic / Electron application that runs on the lab PC and guides the operator through login, packages, stations, appointments and the checkup flow. 
 * Maintaining and improving the Capacitor/Electron build and the GitHub Actions release pipeline. 
 * Owning the device configuration backend, a Django REST backend that stores lab and device configuration, authenticates lab operators, generates signed Google Cloud Storage URLs and receives logs from the field. 
 * Keeping the REST APIs, PostgreSQL models, authentication bridge and upload pipeline secure and reliable.

Product-wide improvements and integrations

 * Driving refactoring, dependency updates and reliability improvements across the Lifestyle Check stack. 
 * Integrating with the wider Wellabe platform: the Laravel/PHP admin platform for device master data, the Flask backend that handles body-age calculations and reporting, and the Ionic/Capacitor mobile app for user-facing results. 
 * Improving observability: centralised logging, clearer error signals and faster remote diagnosis so that "it didn't work in Munich on Tuesday" becomes solvable from your desk. 
 * Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release workflows.

Data quality & collaboration

 * Quality and robustness ownership - you design and maintain solutions that are reliable, fit our business needs and are reasonably easy to operate and maintain. 
 * Careful handling of health data - data protection and security are not a formality here. 
 * Collaboration with our development team.

Your profile
Must-haves

 * Strong Python skills - you can find your way into unfamiliar, grown code and own both Flask and Django backends. 
 * Experience with hardware integration - serial interfaces, Bluetooth, TCP; you can read a device protocol and understand what is happening on the wire. 
 * Frontend skills - solid Angular/TypeScript experience and a practical understanding of Ionic/Capacitor or Electron build chains. 
 * Strong SQL and experience with relational databases (we use PostgreSQL and SQLite). 
 * Remote debugging from incomplete information - you can reconstruct what happened from logs, screenshots and second-hand descriptions, without being able to reproduce the issue locally. 
 * Willingness to travel to our offices in Munich and Vienna, and enjoyment of working with real devices. 
 * Fluent German - you need to communicate with local teams and support staff at our lab sites in German-speaking countries. 
 * Good English - collaboration in an international team.

Nice-to-haves

 * Windows engineering - services, packaging, installers, firewall; our application runs unattended on the on-site PCs. 
 * PyInstaller + NSIS experience, or comparable desktop-deployment tooling. 
 * PHP / Laravel basics so you can read and coordinate changes in our admin platform. 
 * Security awareness - patching, handling secrets, dependency management, GDPR in a health context.

Join our interdisciplinary teams at the interface of technology and fabrication and enjoy Villach's exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Austrian Alps. Be part of something bigger. Be part of Silicon Austria Labs.

The role is part of the new Pilot Line Operations (PLO) Team within the Microsystem Division. PLO is a multidisciplinary engineering team bridging research and pilot-line operations, combining microfabrication expertise, process integration, documentation and coordination between Research Units and the SAL cleanroom infrastructure.

Your future tasks include:
 * Hands-on execution of microfabrication processes across lithography, deposition, etching, cleaning, metrology and other relevant process modules.
 * Develop, integrate, troubleshoot and optimize complex microfabrication process flows, including cross-tool and cross-module interactions.
 * Execute and lead fabrication runs, analyze results and identify process integration issues, deviations and root causes: pilot-line runs, MPWs, technology demonstrators and external fabrication activities.
 * Assessing Technology and pilot-line maturity.
 * Work directly with scientists to translate new research concepts into fabricable process flows and experimental process runs.
 * Work closely with cleanroom tool owners and engineers to ensure compatibility with tool capabilities, cleanroom constraints and operational requirements.
 * Define and maintain process documentation, flow diagrams, process specifications, run sheets, recipes, track of changes and lessons learned.
 * Help establish standardized ways of working for process development, integration, documentation, qualification and scale-up.
 * Platform Specialization: Focusing primarily on one of the key Microsystems technology platforms (Quantum Technologies, Photonics, PiezoMEMS, Magnetic Microsystems) but operating across multiple projects.

Your profile:
 * MSc/PhD in microelectronics, microsystems, semiconductors, physics or a related field.
 * 5+ years of hands-on experience in semiconductor, MEMS, photonics or microfabrication technology, preferably in a cleanroom industrial environment.
 * Demonstrated expertise in fabrication process development and integration, with the ability to execute and troubleshoot processes. 
 * Broad understanding of multiple microfabrication modules and their interactions, rather than expertise limited to a single process step. 
 * Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to move between hands-on cleanroom work, process engineering, documentation and coordination. 
 * Strong organizational and documentation skills for technical reporting and professional documentation. 
 * Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively while supporting multiple stakeholders.
 * Excellent teamwork, communication, reporting, and organizational skills.

Your future responsibilities
We are seeking a motivated Master Student to carry out a Master Thesis in the field of nonlinear integrated photonics, in collaboration with an established industrial and research partner. This thesis focuses on advanced optical modulation techniques and experimental characterization of photonic systems. You will work on the implementation and analysis of coherent modulation schemes, including IQ modulation for carrier-suppressed single-sideband (CS-SSB) operation and dual-sideband modulation. The work combines numerical modeling, hands-on experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations using heterodyne measurement techniques. If you are eager to deepen your expertise in integrated photonics, optical modulation, and experimental photonics, this thesis offers an excellent opportunity to develop strong technical and research skills.

 * Experimental characterization of photonic and acousto-optic components:
 ** Characterizing the performance of an acousto-optic modulator (AOM).
 ** Setting up and performing heterodyne measurement experiments.
 ** Analyzing measured data and extracting key performance metrics.
